Under-19 World Championship|2009 New Zealand]]|[[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|Team]]}} }} '''Arnett Nathaniel Moultrie''' (born November 18, 1990) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Pioneros de Los Mochis]] of the [[CIBACOPA]]. He played college basketball with the [[UTEP Miners basketball|UTEP Miners]] and [[Mississippi State Bulldogs basketball|Mississippi State Bulldogs]]. ==High school== In Moultrie's junior season at [[Raleigh-Egypt High School]], he averaged 15 points, 8 rebounds and 2 blocks per game. In his senior season, he averaged 15 points, 8 rebounds and 4 blocks per game. ==College career== ===Freshman season=== In Moultrie's freshman season at [[UTEP]], he averaged 8.8 points and 8.2 rebounds per game. He was also named to the Conference USA All-Freshman Team. Moultrie averaged 13.2 points and 8.7 rebounds per game in the [[College Basketball Invitational]] as UTEP lost in the final round to [[Oregon State]].{{cite web|title=Arnett Moultrie Profile|url=http://www.hailstate.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=16800&ATCLID=205027519|work=Mississippi State University Bulldogs Official Athletics site|access-date=June 22, 2012}} ===Sophomore season=== In his sophomore season at UTEP, Moultrie averaged 9.8 points and 6.7 rebounds per game. In the Conference-USA Tournament, Moultrie averaged 12.0 points per game and earned a spot on the all-tournament team. ===Junior season=== Moultrie was forced to sit out a season after transferring to [[Mississippi State Bulldogs basketball|Mississippi State]]. In his first and only season playing for Mississippi State, ([[2011–12 Mississippi State Bulldogs basketball team|2011–12]]), Moultrie averaged 16.4 points and 10.5 rebounds per game.{{cite web|title=Arnett Moultrie Profile|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/_/id/6612/arnett-moultrie|work=[[ESPN]]|access-date=June 22, 2012}} He was also named to the All-SEC men's basketball team.{{cite web|title=2012 SEC Men's Basketball Awards Announced|url=http://www.secdigitalnetwork.com/NEWS/tabid/473/Article/232339/2012-sec-mens-basketball-awards-announced.aspx|access-date=June 22, 2012}} On March 28, 2012, Moultrie decided to enter his name in the [[2012 NBA draft]].{{cite web|last=Marcello|first=Brandon|title=Moultrie to declare for NBA Draft, end career at MSU|url=http://blogs.clarionledger.com/msu/2012/03/28/moultrie-expects-to-sign-with-agent-end-msu-career/|access-date=June 22, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120501065217/http://blogs.clarionledger.com/msu/2012/03/28/moultrie-expects-to-sign-with-agent-end-msu-career/|archive-date=May 1, 2012|url-status=dead}} ==Professional career== Moultrie was drafted with the 27th pick in the [[2012 NBA draft]] by the [[Miami Heat]]. He was then traded to the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] for [[Justin Hamilton (basketball, born 1990)|Justin Hamilton]] and a future first-round draft pick.{{cite web|title=Sixers get Arnett Moultrie from Heat|url=http://www.nba.com/2012/news/06/28/draft-heat-76ers-trade.ap/|work=NBA.com|date=June 28, 2012|access-date=August 25, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120703050820/http://www.nba.com/2012/news/06/28/draft-heat-76ers-trade.ap/|archive-date=July 3, 2012|url-status=dead}} On December 21, 2012, Moultrie was assigned to the [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]] of the [[NBA D-League]].{{Cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/philadelphia_76ers_assign_first_round_pick_arnett_moultrie_sioux_falls_skyforce_2012_12_21.html |title=Philadelphia 76ers Assign First-Round Draft Pick Arnett Moultrie to NBA D-League Affiliate Sioux Falls Skyforce |website=[[NBA.com]] |access-date=December 21, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151016041530/http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/philadelphia_76ers_assign_first_round_pick_arnett_moultrie_sioux_falls_skyforce_2012_12_21.html |archive-date=October 16, 2015 |url-status=dead }} He was recalled on January 6, 2013.[http://www.nba.com/sixers/news/sixers-recall-arnett-moultrie-d-league-and-waive-maalik-wayns Sixers Recall Arnett Moultrie From D-League And Waive Maalik Wayns] On February 4, 2014, he was assigned to the [[Delaware 87ers]].[http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=15179 Sixers assign Arnett Moultrie, Lorenzo Brown to D-League] On February 9, 2014, he was recalled by the 76ers.[http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=15197 Sixers call Arnett Moultrie from D-League] On February 21, 2014, Moultrie had his first career start. In 31 minutes, he recorded 6 points, 5 rebounds and 2 steals in a 112–124 loss to the Dallas Mavericks.[http://www.nba.com/games/20140221/DALPHI/gameinfo.html Notebook: Mavericks 124, 76ers 112] On March 15, 2014, he was reassigned to the 87ers.[http://www.nba.com/sixers/news/140315-moultrie-87ers Sixers Assign Arnett Moultrie to Delaware 87ers] On March 31, 2014, he was suspended for five games for violating the NBA's anti-drug policy.{{cite web|last=Wolf|first=Jason|title=76ers' Arnett Moultrie suspended for drug violation|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/sixers/2014/03/31/arnett-moultrie-suspension-drug-test-violation-philadelphia-76ers/7122373/|work=USAToday.com|date=March 31, 2014|access-date=April 14, 2014}} On April 6, 2014, he was again recalled to the 76ers. On October 27, 2014, he was traded to the [[New York Knicks]] in exchange for [[Travis Outlaw]], a 2019 second-round draft selection and the option exchange 2018 second-round draft selections. Upon acquisition, he was waived by the Knicks.[http://www.nba.com/knicks/news/knicks-complete-trade-philadelphia Knicks Complete Trade with Philadelphia] On December 16, 2014, he signed with the [[Jiangsu Dragons]] of the [[Chinese Basketball Association]].[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/asia/145034/arnett-moultrie-signs-in-china-with-jiangsu-nangang.html Arnett Moultrie signs in China with Jiangsu Nangang] On December 5, 2015, Moultrie signed with [[Sporting Al Riyadi Beirut|Al-Riyadi Beirut]] of Lebanon.{{cite web|last=Saddi|first=Michel|title=Al Riyadi lands Arnett Moultrie, ex Jiangsu D.|url=http://www.asia-basket.com/Lebanon/news/430339/Al-Riyadi-lands-Arnett-Moultrie,-ex-Jiangsu-D.|work=Asia-Basket.com|date=December 5, 2015|access-date=December 5, 2015|archive-date=February 20, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160220183822/http://www.asia-basket.com/Lebanon/news/430339/Al-Riyadi-lands-Arnett-Moultrie,-ex-Jiangsu-D.|url-status=dead}} In March 2018, Moultrie signed with the [[NLEX Road Warriors]] of the [[Philippine Basketball Association]] as their import for the [[2018 PBA Commissioner's Cup]].{{cite web|url=https://www.spin.ph/basketball/pba/news/nlex-taps-former-nba-player-arnett-moultrie-as-commissioners-cup-import|title=NLEX goes big with former NBA player Arnett Moultrie as Commissioner's Cup import |first=Karlo|last=Sacamos|date=March 6, 2018}} In November 2018, Moultrie signed with [[BC Kalev/Cramo|Kalev/Cramo]] of the [[Latvian–Estonian Basketball League]] (LEBL) and the [[VTB United League]].{{cite web|title=Kalev/Cramo signs Arnett Moultrie|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/kalev-cramo-signs-arnett-moultrie/|work=Sportando|date=November 26, 2018|access-date=December 18, 2018}} His first game for the team was in the VTB United League as he scored 16 points and grabbed 9 rebounds in 26 minutes against [[Parma Basket|Parma]] as Kalev/Cramo won 93–82.{{cite web|title=Kalev 93 - 82 PARMA|url=http://www.vtb-league.com/en/game/3576361/#stat|work=VTB United League|date=December 7, 2018|access-date=December 18, 2018}} In December 2019, Arnett moved to the [[Beijing Royal Fighters]] of the Chinese Basketball Association.{{cite news |title=Arnett Moultrie: Agrees to contract with Beijing |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/arnett-moultrie-agrees-to-contract-with-beijing/ |access-date=October 6, 2020 |work=CBSSports.com |date=December 8, 2019}} He debuted on January 5, 2020, as club won 112–96 against [[Shanghai Sharks]]. Moultrie averaged 18.8 points and 11.3 rebounds per game. On October 29, 2020, he signed with the [[Nanjing Monkey Kings]].{{cite news |title=Arnett Moultrie signs with Nanjing Tongxi Monkey Kings |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/arnett-moultrie-signs-with-nanjing-tongxi-monkey-kings/ |website=Sportando |access-date=October 29, 2020 |date=October 29, 2020|last1=Lupo |first1=Nicola }} On March 28, 2021, Moultrie scored 37 points and grabbed a career-high 34 rebounds in a 105–95 victory over the [[Jiangsu Dragons]]. His 34 rebounds were five rebounds short of breaking the [[Chinese Basketball Association records|CBA record]] for most rebounds in a single game.{{cite web|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/international/boxscores/2021-03-28-jiangsu-dragons.html|title=CBA China - Nanjing Monkey Kings at Jiangsu Dragons, Mar 28, 2021|date=March 28, 2021|publisher=Basketball Reference|accessdate=June 15, 2021}} On March 8, 2023, [[Taichung Suns]] registered Arnett as import player.{{cite press release |title=2023.03.08聯盟公告 |url=https://t1league.basketball/announcements/1120 |accessdate=March 8, 2023 |work=T1 League |date=March 8, 2023}} On March 9, Arnett signed with the [[Taichung Suns]] of the [[T1 League]].{{cite news |title=太陽註銷艾倫有原因 找來的新洋將莫爾特里曾在CBA殺翻天 |url=https://sports.ltn.com.tw/news/breakingnews/4234373 |accessdate=March 9, 2023 |work=Liberty Times Net |date=March 9, 2023}} On August 12, 2024, Arnett signed with the [[Maccabi Rishon LeZion (basketball)|Maccabi Rishon LeZion]] of the [[Liga Leumit (basketball)|Liga Leumit]].{{cite web |title=ברוך הבא ארנט! |url=https://www.maccabirishon.co.il/news?NewsId=34690 |publisher=מכבי ראשון לציון האתר הרשמי |access-date=September 17, 2024 |date=August 12, 2024}}{{cite web |title=Arnett Moultrie (ex Qingdao E.) is a newcomer at M.Rishon |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Israel/news/886850/Arnett-Moultrie-(ex-Qingdao-E.)-is-a-newcomer-at-M.Rishon |publisher=Eurobasket.com |access-date=September 17, 2024 |date=August 13, 2024}} On November 22, he signed with the [[Taipei Fubon Braves]] of the [[P. League+]].{{cite web |title=富邦勇士簽下前NBA費城禁區長人 他2度回鍋台籃 |url=https://sports.ettoday.net/news/2859882 |publisher=ETtoday |access-date=November 22, 2024 |date=November 22, 2024}} On February 2, 2025, he |date=February 2, 2025}} On February 7, 2025, Moultrie signed with the [[Kaohsiung Aquas]] of the [[Taiwan Professional Basketball League]] (TPBL).{{cite news |title=海神新春補強 前富邦勇士摩爾特里加盟助陣 rosters.{{cite news|title=TPBL最終註冊名單公佈 7隊洋將正式底定 |url=https://sports.ettoday.net/news/2936920 |accessdate=April 3, 2025 |work=ETtoday |date=April 3, 2025 }} And [[Kaohsiung Aquas]] terminated the
